title: review.schema.json / peer-review.schema.json consumer catalog
content: Load-bearing-contract consumer catalog for plugins/pipeline/schemas/review.schema.json (Phase 2, architectural-tier reviewer blocks) and plugins/pipeline/schemas/peer-review.schema.json (Phase 4 panel blocks), seeded post-merge of #40 (merged to main as 7a052d3) from the three-layer survey #40's own map.json performed as the donor shape (spec.json's own knowledge-drift claim flagged that no catalog existed for either file before this run, medium severity, now closed by this file). PROVENANCE: surveyed at worktree HEAD 3b87a98 / 48afa11762dc3793732588db4f172d3cb362a4e9 during #40's Phase 0.5/2.5; #40 shipped as 7a052d3 (squash of PR #72) on main. Re-verify against the shipped commit before trusting a line number cited here, per this store's own source-precedence rule. THREE-LAYER SURVEY, review.schema.json#/definitions/agentBlock/properties/concerns/items (Phase 2 reviewer concerns: BA, DBA, DevOps, SecOps, Design at architectural tier) and the sibling vulnerabilities[].remediation field: (1) application-code call sites: validate-pipeline-artifact.mjs's reviewerRules (review.<role>.json whole-file, review.json /<role> slice) validate the shape; gate-phase-entry.mjs reads review.json for PRESENCE and a phase token only, never concerns; gate-pre-phase4-frontend.mjs reads review.design_review.json as a fallback evidence source keyed off design-gate fields, not concerns; knowledge-store.mjs's ARCHIVE_ARTIFACTS includes "review" and archives the file wholesale, shape-agnostic. (2) data-layer-resident readers: none -- this project has no database function/view bodies; review.json is a flat file artifact. (3) independent re-derivations: plugins/pipeline/agents/{dba,devops,secops,design}.md each restate the concern shape in their own artifact-contract block (hand-maintained mirrors of the schema, drift silently); plugins/pipeline/commands/pipeline.md's Phase 2 dispatch block (~lines 223-355 as of #40; re-derive by section heading, not the raw number) restates the shard shape. THREE-LAYER SURVEY, peer-review.schema.json#/definitions/panelVerdict/properties/concerns/items (Phase 4 panel concerns, all six core roles plus design_review): (1) application-code call sites: validate-pipeline-artifact.mjs's panelVerdict rules cover ba/dba/devops/secops/dev/qa; merge-peer-review.mjs's hasRecoverableVerdict reads ONLY block.verdict and is fail-CLOSED (exit 2) on verdict absence/malformation, never reads concerns; gate-phase-entry.mjs reads peer-review.json presence plus a phase token only; gate-pre-phase4-frontend.mjs reads peer-review.design_review.json as an evidence source; knowledge-store.mjs's ARCHIVE_ARTIFACTS includes "peer-review". (2) data-layer-resident readers: none. (3) independent re-derivations: plugins/pipeline/agents/{ba,dba,devops,secops,dev,qa,design}.md (7 of 9 agent definitions) restate the concern shape; plugins/pipeline/commands/pipeline.md's shared Phase 4 preamble (the ten-copy replicated block, see knowledge/living-context/architecture--agent-contract-replication-digest.json) and its delta re-review preamble restate governing rules for the panel; plugins/pipeline/tests/test-validate-pipeline-artifact.sh asserts the self-test reports ZERO failures over crafted panelVerdict fixtures. CRITICAL GAP CARRIED FORWARD FROM #40's map.json, NOT CLOSED BY THIS CATALOG: peer-review.schema.json declares NO `art_director` property, and validate-pipeline-artifact.mjs's AGENT_RULES has NO art-director entry, so the Art Director's peer-review.art_director.json shard is validated by NOTHING mechanical at all -- only art-director.md's own prose (which already states the property-not-a-fix rule at its own :52) reaches that role. review.schema.json#/vulnerabilities[].remediation has ZERO code readers as of #40 (grepped plugins/, knowledge/, .github/, README.md for the literal `remediation`: every hit outside secops.md and review.schema.json is prose or an archived artifact); this field is cheap to rename precisely because nothing computational depends on its current shape, which is itself worth recording so a future author does not assume otherwise. GOVERNANCE NOTE inherited from architecture--pipeline-artifact-validation-gaps.json and load-bearing for this catalog: the concerns[].must_satisfy field #40 added is typed and REQUIRED on review.schema.json's agentBlock concerns.items, but typed and NOT required on peer-review.schema.json's panelVerdict concerns.items (requiring it there reddened three self-test cases in a file #40 was forbidden to edit, per #38) -- so the Phase 4 panel half of the property-not-implementation rule is enforced by agent prose only, not by schema, until #38 closes that gap.
